findings.body: The latest proof list explicitly leaves this behavior without runtime proof. The FIFO test releases the first model and waits for the entire Forge command to exit; the view test holds a single launch. Neither observes a command between launches while another agent waits. Existing nudge/retry tests check completion without competing admission, so reserving separately for each launch could pass them while violating the approved parent-holds-admission rule. Extend a command-level case to require the same entry and admission through a commit nudge or retry, with the waiter remaining queued.
findings.title: Not done: agent admission survives sequential model launches

findings.body: This still assumes every recorded child leads its own process group. The supported older PR checker launches Autoreview without group options at tests/fixtures/pr-check-before-branch-diff/review.py:531–533. On POSIX, codex._stop signals the group named by that child's pid, which does not exist; the child survives and stop refuses without freeing its place. Actual older Claude workers and readers have the same problem. The existing-queue test converts a newly grouped launch's record, so it does not exercise an actual ungrouped launch. Verify group ownership and support safely terminating these existing processes.
findings.title: Handle existing agents without a dedicated process group

findings.body: Admission snapshots configuration, but later selections never update the lane entry. Autoreview defaults and fallback only update selected at review.py:603–611; split design fallback replaces chosen at worker.py:165. Default readers also join with an empty selection at story.py:222 and :230: repo.models returns {} when unconfigured (repo.py:411–419), while actual Claude/Codex selections update only run progress (repo.py:278–283 and codex.py:384–386). Thus lanes can report null or the previous model while the item's activity reports the actual selection. Refresh the shared entry for review, worker fallback and both reader providers.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the provider selects its model and effort

findings.body: Actual test commands still bypass these shared entries: fasttest.py:271 launches directly, and review.py:279–288 uses the separate ticket queue. Consequently, board cannot expose their lane output/progress, and stop cannot cancel tests or end an item's worker and test together. plans/FORGE-LANES-1.md:142 assigns that integration and its command-level checks to TESTS, so this remains deferred advice for that task rather than an AGENTS blocker.
findings.title: Later: connect test entries and cancellation in TESTS
